name: B10-0517/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Case of Eritrean Swedish journalist Dawit Isaak, arbitrarily detained in Eritrea
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Eritrean-Swedish journalist Dawit Isaak, arbitrarily detained in Eritrea
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Dawit Isaak, a Swedish-Eritrean journalist held in Eritrea for 25 years without charge or trial, along with other detained journalists and writers. It asks Eritrea to prove they are alive, say where they are held, and let families, doctors and lawyers see them. It also condemns Eritrea's wider human rights abuses and asks European Union bodies and member states to press the case with Eritrea's authorities. This is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- Nothing changes immediately; the Parliament is asking Eritrea to free Isaak and the others.
- It affects Isaak, the other detained journalists, their families, and Eritrea's government.
- Next: European Union diplomats raise the case with Eritrea, and the Parliament is briefed within three months.
